t: FloPlast 65mm square downpipe socket for efficient rainwater drainage systems. Constructed from high quality black uPVC, this robust square socket offers an attractive rectilinear profile and ensures secure connections for effective rainwater management. It is suitable for both new build and refurbishment projects on various properties. The design requires no lubrication during installation, saving time on site. This durable fitting is compatible with most major guttering manufacturers, providing a reliable solution for roofline drainage.
